projects.title: Obsidian Optics
projects.description: A high-performance real-time edge computer vision pipeline using YOLOv8 and PyTorch for multi-object tracking and zone analytics.
projects.longDescription: Obsidian Optics is a deep learning computer vision system designed for intelligent video analytics. It leverages custom-trained YOLOv8 weights optimized for edge devices (Jetson Nano/Raspberry Pi) and provides multi-object tracking (DeepSORT) with real-time speed. Built with a full dashboard, it tracks entry-exit counts, custom bounding zones, and thermal density estimation inside recorded streams, displaying analytical heatmaps using D3.js and WebSockets.

projects.title: Daily Decipher
projects.description: An automated AI newsletter summarization engine that aggregates technical publications and outputs high-signal digests.
projects.longDescription: Daily Decipher is a personal aggregator and summarizer. It periodically crawls top-tier machine learning publications (arXiv, Hugging Face Daily, TechCrunch) and stock market blogs. Using Gemini 1.5/3.5 models via a custom multi-agent structure, it parses dense technical texts, summarizes them into structured Markdown, extracts core sentiments, and automatically distributes them to a Telegram group and email subscribers via Mailgun.

projects.title: BullRun Analytics
projects.description: Financial sentiment analyzer correlating global financial news and Reddit trends with technical market indicators.
projects.longDescription: BullRun Analytics represents my stock market learning journey. It is a full-stack engine that tracks tickers, performs text sentiment classification using FinBERT, and overlays these sentiment indexes on stock charts. Users can visualize correlation peaks between social media hype (Reddit /r/wallstreetbets) and actual volume breakouts, utilizing a React financial charting interface.

projects.title: Cognitive Canvas
projects.description: A media resource hub that translates conceptual sketches and raw assets into high-CTR graphic templates.
projects.longDescription: Cognitive Canvas merges my skill as a Freelance Thumbnail Designer with software. It uses AI diffusion models and canvas-based layering (React Konva) to let creators draft design assets rapidly. Users can upload rough layouts, write text prompts, and watch the system generate aesthetic, high-contrast, clickable thumbnail compositions ready for export in 4K resolution.
